OpenSpiel Environment

Space · openenv/openspiel_env

Play OpenSpiel games (Catch, Cliff Walking, 2048, Blackjack, Tic-Tac-Toe, Kuhn Poker) against a simple bot opponent.

Each step returns a reward and done flag from the OpenSpiel game; the card gives no further detail.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

docker run -p 8000:8000 \
  -e OPENSPIEL_GAME=tic_tac_toe \
  -e OPENSPIEL_OPPONENT_POLICY=first \
  openspiel-env:latest

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/openenv/openspiel_env
cd openspiel_env

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Docker.
